hints.tr: Aynı `GROUP BY` içinde birden çok toplama işlevi kullanabiliyorsun.
hints.en: You can use several aggregate functions inside the same `GROUP BY`.

hints.tr: `MIN` ve `MAX` sayılarda olduğu gibi metinlerde de çalışıyor; burada fiyat sütununu kullanıyorsun.
hints.en: `MIN` and `MAX` work on text as well as numbers; here you use the price column.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
SELECT category,
       COUNT(*) AS item_count,
       MIN(price) AS cheapest,
       MAX(price) AS priciest
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
SELECT category,
       COUNT(*) AS item_count,
       MIN(price) AS cheapest,
       MAX(price) AS priciest
FROM products
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;
```
